trigger.request_payload: Reframed after AOF pre-implementation ownership audit: implement and release QIF v0.8.11 by extending qif-ledger, the existing owner of PortableKnowledgeIncidentClosure, with immutable PortableKnowledgeLateSignal, PortableKnowledgeIncidentReopenDecision, and PortableKnowledgeClosureCalibration records. Preserve occurrence versus receipt time, source and closure traceability, materiality, accountable human authority, append-only history, governance routing, and QIF verifier limits. Do not duplicate lifecycle ownership in calibration-report, mutate original closure, reopen automatically, infer causality, treat counts as quality, or claim semantic truth. Use AOF v12.2.0 and maintain at least three future roadmap horizons.

outcome_reports.note: QIF v0.8.11 late-signal, accountable reopen-decision, and closure-calibration runtime passed full QIF and AOF verification and is release-ready.
